projects.title: National Robotics Challenge Micromouse - Senior Design
projects.description:
Worked in a team of engineering students to design and construct an autonomous 
maze-solving robot to compete in the 2023 National Robotics Micromouse 
Challenge located in Marion, Ohio. Our design utilizes three vl53l0x time-of-flight sensors and a motor encoder to navigate. 

Utilized MCUXpresso, C, FRDM-KL25Z MUC, Analog Discovery 2.

projects.title: Ball Following Robot - Logic and Computer Design
projects.description:
This was a project for my logic and computer design class that challenged us students to demonstrate our knowledge of Verilog and FPGA boards. Designed and constructed a robot that detected and follow a ball. 

Utilized an Arduino Uno PixyCam, DE1-Soc board, C, and Verilog.
